        long res = 1;

            if ((exp & 1) == 1) res = (res * base) % MOD;
            base = (base * base) % MOD;

    static void fwt(int[] a, int lim) {

        for (int i = 0; i < lim; ++i) {
            a[i] = (a[i] + a[i + lim]) % MOD;
            if (a[i] < 0) a[i] += MOD;

            a[i] = (a[i] - a[i + lim] + MOD) % MOD;
        }
        fwt2(a, lim);
        fwt2(a, lim + lim);
    }

    static boolean nextPermutation(int[] arr, int len) {
        int i = len - 2;
        while (i >= 0 && arr[i] >= arr[i + 1]) {
            i--;
        }
        if (i < 0) return false;
        
        int j = len - 1;
        while (arr[j] <= arr[i]) {
            j--;
        }
        
        int temp = arr[i];
        arr[i] = arr[j];
        arr[j] = temp;
        
        reverse(arr, i + 1, len - 1);
        return true;
    }
    
    static void reverse(int[] arr, int start, int end) {
        while (start < end) {
            int temp = arr[start];
            arr[start] = arr[end];
            arr[end] = temp;
            start++;
            end--;
        }
    }
